profile.headline: Software Engineer at BAE Systems, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a software engineer, I work on both research and production applications for the Air Force Research Laboratory 711th Human Performance Wing. My focus is on Android application development, including applications for enhancing communications and for digital medical documentation. (From May 2020 until its February 2024 acquisition by BAE Systems, I worked for Ball Aerospace in this role.)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: As an ORISE intern within the Air Force Research Laboratory 711th Human Performance Wing, I worked on various projects related to virtual audio and communications systems. This includes building on existing systems and working on entirely new projects.

company.name: Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As a GTA, I was responsible for leading labs for Wright State's Computer Organization course. This course is part of the core Computer Science curriculum. All Computer Science and Computer Engineering students take this course in their second year. I was responsible for 30-40 students. My responsibilities included guiding students through completing the lab work and grading lab material.

positions.title: Student Help Desk Assistant
positions.description: As a computer support assistant, I troubleshooted various computer software and hardware issues for Wright State staff and students. This involved answering questions both in-person and over the phone.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description: As a cashier, I was responsible for scanning customer items for check-out, re-stocking the area around the cash registers, helping customers locate items, and providing general customer service. This was a seasonal position.

positions.title: Page
positions.description: As a page, I assisted in day-to-day operations of the library. These included shelving/locating items, checking items out to patrons, packing items to be shipped out, and answering questions both in-person and over the phone.

honors.title: University Libraries Top Scholar 2019
honors.description: I was selected as the University Libraries Top Scholar for the College of Computer Science and Engineering. The award goes to one graduating senior from each of Wright State's academic colleges based on academic performance.
honors.issuer: Issued by Wright State University Libraries · Apr 2019
